description: This file defines a specialized Vectorized class for c10::qint32 type, implementing vectorized operations and conversions for quantized 32-bit integers using VSX intrinsics, primarily for efficient quantized type processing in PyTorch.

classes.name: Vectorized<c10::qint32>
classes.description: A vectorized class for c10::qint32 type, providing SIMD operations, load/store, dequantization, quantization, and element-wise operators using VSX intrinsics.

methods.name: loadu
methods.description: Loads unaligned vectorized data from memory into a Vectorized<c10::qint32> object.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores the Vectorized<c10::qint32> data into memory.

methods.name: dequantize
methods.description: Converts quantized integers to floating point vectors given scale and zero point.

methods.name: quantize
methods.description: Quantizes floating point vectors into integers with specified scale and zero point.

methods.name: relu
methods.description: Applies ReLU activation to the vector.

methods.name: relu6
methods.description: Applies ReLU6 activation to the vector.

methods.name: widening_subtract
methods.description: Performs widening subtraction with another Vectorized<c10::qint32>.

methods.name: requantize_from_int
methods.description: Requantizes integer vectors from higher precision with a multiplier and zero point.
